decks.name: LeetCode #355 - Design Twitter
decks.description: Design simplified Twitter with post, follow, and news feed features

cards.question: Design Twitter: Design a simplified version of Twitter where users can post tweets, follow/unfollow another user, and is able to see the 10 most recent tweets in the user's news feed. Implement the Twitter class: Twitter() initializes your twitter object. void postTweet(int userId, int tweetId) composes a new tweet with ID tweetId by the user userId. Each call to this function will be made with a unique tweetId. List<Integer> getNewsFeed(int userId) retrieves the 10 most recent tweet IDs in the user's news feed. Each item in the news feed must be posted by users who the user followed or by the user themself. Tweets must be ordered from most recent to least recent. void follow(int followerId, int followeeId) the user with ID followerId started following the user with ID followeeId. void unfollow(int followerId, int followeeId) the user with ID followerId started unfollowing the user with ID followeeId.

solutions.name: Sorting
solutions.explanation: Store tweets with timestamps and follow relationships. For news feed, collect all tweets from user and followees, sort by timestamp descending, return top 10. Simple but inefficient as it sorts all tweets every time. O(n*m + t log t) time for getNewsFeed where n is followees, m is max tweets per user, t is total tweets to sort. Other operations O(1).

solutions.name: Heap
solutions.explanation: Use min-heap to efficiently merge k sorted lists (each user's tweets chronologically). Store tweets with negative timestamps for max-heap behavior. For news feed, add most recent tweet from each followee to heap, pop minimum (most recent), add next tweet from same user. Process only 10 tweets needed. O(n log n) time for getNewsFeed where n is number of followees. Space efficient as heap size bounded by followees count.

solutions.timeComplexity: O(n log n) for getNewsFeed, O(1) for others
solutions.timeDescription: GetNewsFeed processes at most 10 tweets with heap operations on n followees, resulting in O(n log n) where n is number of followees
solutions.spaceDescription: Store m tweets per N users, M followees per user, plus heap of size n for current followees
solutions.exampleWalkthrough: User 1 follows 2 and 3. Each user has tweets. GetNewsFeed(1): add most recent from users 1,2,3 to heap. Pop minimum (most recent), add next tweet from that user. Continue until 10 tweets or heap empty. Efficiently merges three sorted lists.

solutions.name: Heap (Optimal)
solutions.explanation: Enhanced heap solution with space optimizations. Limit each user to last 10 tweets only. For users with 10+ followees, use max-heap to pre-filter to 10 best candidates before merging. Reduces memory for high-volume users and improves performance when many followees. O(n) average time for getNewsFeed with optimizations. Space bounded by keeping only 10 tweets per user. Best practical performance.
